plate_comment: The read-back check of one discrete output: when the read-back line disagrees with the commanded logical output it debounces (commanded on, reads off: on_mismatch_count, then up to auxiliary_driver_toggle_count_limit retries of the output in retry_count, then the high fault bit; commanded off, reads on: off_mismatch_count, then the low fault bit); while they agree a registered fault clears after its recovery count. Outputs 19 / 20 (the cruise vent / vacuum solenoids) use the cruise thresholds and the vacuum throttle actuator state (was diag_faultMatch_outputCheck_update)

Runs cm848_checkDiscreteOutputReadBack for 11 discrete outputs (A/C, engine brake 1, intake air heaters 1 / 2, lift pump, transmission relay / overdrive / converter clutch, cruise vent / vacuum / servo supply) every fifth pass with the key on; at a key-off it turns the heater and lift pump outputs off (was cm848_mainLoopMonitor)
Clears the 11 outputs' read-back counters and retry counts (was cm848_initSensorCalibration)
